description: Checks where a business appears in Google Maps results for one search phrase, searched from one point (latitude and longitude). Returns its rank, the number of results seen, and up to 5 competitors ranked above it with their ratings and review counts.

business_name.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

keyword.description: The search a customer would type, e.g. "pizza near me".

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search from.

lng.description: Longitude of the point to search from.

name: check_local_rank
title: Check local search rank on Google Maps
